languageModel.argument: The sentence lists three course codes followed by 'and', which groups them as a required set (all_of). According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition, the 'or' creates a path where any one option fulfills the parent condition, while the initial 'and' implies all preceding items are required per the standard interpretation of comma-separated lists ending in 'and' within prerequisite logic.
